title: 第25章 这女人一刀捅腰子第26章 不对这些分身身上有毒气
slug: 玄幻穿成野狗生崽就能变强
lines: 巫风的翅膀无声展开，靠灵力托着身体滑翔，落在后院围墙上。
石阶口的长明灯旁边，两个看守靠在墙上打盹。
巫风的翅尖划过，两道风压拍在后颈。
两个看守的脑袋同时歪下去，身体滑到地上。
巫风顺着石阶钻进地牢，断爪在铁门上一拧，锁扣碎了。
林野从笼子里站起来，妖力一震，铁笼的栏杆从焊接处整齐断裂，落了一地。
他走到昏过去的看守脑袋上，开始搜寻活人浅层意识的记忆碎片。
看守的脑子里翻来覆去就那么几件事，巡逻路线，换班时间，还有库房。
库房在后院西侧，地下第二层，三道灵力锁，钥匙在顾元魁书房的暗格里。
好在库房本身的防护阵法等级不高，筑基期的灵力就能硬破。
林野收回妖力，转头看巫风。
“后院西侧，地下第二层。库房。把里面的东西全搬走。”
巫风翅膀一收，转身就往外钻。
林野站在长廊中央，扫了一圈四周的铁笼。
所有妖兽都在看他，连凡兽都从趴伏的姿势里微微抬起了头
林野没释放妖威，就那么站着，等了一刻钟。
巫风回来了，嘴里叼着一只储物袋。
储物袋扔在林野爪前，袋口敞开。
丹药，符篆，灵石，挤了满满一袋，品阶从低到中都有。
林野挑出几瓶低阶的淬体丹和回气丹。
“分给它们。”
巫风叼起丹瓶，挨个笼子塞。
连凡兽的大笼子里，都被丢进去几颗低阶的洗髓丹。
妖兽们愣了。
林野的传音术覆盖整条长廊。
“一刻钟后，我会去破牢。”
“顾元魁，我带走。剩下的人，你们自己处置。”
两头灰狼妖四条腿撑在地上，喉咙里滚出咆哮。
花斑蟒蛇妖的身子缓缓展开，吐着信子。
巫风出去片刻，从长廊尽头飞回来。
“隔音符咒贴好了。这个府邸内的动静，外面听不见。”
凡兽们趴在笼底，四条腿缩在肚子下面，它们听不懂传音术。
但恐惧之后，是一种更原始的冲动。
野猪里最老的那头趴了半天，终于把脑袋抬起来，朝林野的方向拱了三下。
其余凡兽跟着趴低身子，前腿弯折，额头贴地。
野猪吞下丹药，皮毛炸开又伏下，浑身出现了一层灵光。
content_en:
Wu Feng's wings spread out silently, gliding with his spiritual power supporting his body, and landed on the backyard fence.
Next to the long light at the entrance of the stone steps, two guards leaned against the wall and took a nap.
The tips of Wu Feng's wings passed by, and two gusts of wind pressure hit the back of his neck.
The heads of the two guards tilted down at the same time, and their bodies slid to the ground.
Wu Feng climbed into the dungeon along the stone steps, twisted his broken claw on the iron door, and the lock broke.
Lin Ye stood up from the cage, his demon power shook, and the railings of the iron cage broke neatly from the welding joints and fell to the ground.
He walked up to the head of the unconscious guard and began to search for memory fragments of the living person's shallow consciousness.
There were just a few things running through the guard's mind: patrol routes, shift change times, and the warehouse.
The warehouse is on the west side of the backyard, on the second underground floor, with three spiritual locks, and the key is in the secret room of Gu Yuankui's study.
Fortunately, the level of the protective formation in the warehouse itself is not high, and the spiritual power in the foundation building stage can break through it.
Lin Ye withdrew his demon power and turned to look at Wu Feng.
"On the west side of the backyard, on the second underground floor. Warehouse. Move everything inside."
Wu Feng retracted his wings, turned around and dived out.
Lin Ye stood in the center of the corridor and scanned the surrounding iron cages.
All the monsters and beasts were looking at him, and even the mortal beasts raised their heads slightly from their prone positions.
Lin Ye didn't release his demon power, just stood there and waited for a quarter of an hour.
Wu Feng came back with a storage bag in his mouth.
The storage bag was thrown in front of Linye Claw, the mouth of the bag was open.
There was a bag full of elixirs, talismans, and spirit stones, ranging from low to medium grade.
Lin Ye picked out a few bottles of low-level body-tempering pills and Qi-restoring pills.
"Give it to them."
Wu Feng picked up the elixir bottles and stuffed them into cages one after another.
Even the large cage of the mortal beast had a few low-level marrow-cleansing pills thrown into it.
The monsters were stunned.
Lin Ye's sound transmission technique covers the entire corridor.
"In a quarter of an hour, I will break the cell."
"Gu Yuankui, I'll take them away. You can handle the rest by yourself."
The two gray wolf monsters stood on the ground with four legs, roaring from their throats.
The body of the piebald python demon slowly unfolded and spit out the letter.
Wu Feng went out for a while and flew back from the end of the corridor.
"The soundproofing charm has been put on. No movement in this mansion can be heard outside."
The mortal beasts were lying on the bottom of the cage, with their four legs tucked under their bellies. They couldn't understand the sound transmission technique.
But behind fear is a more primal impulse.
The oldest wild boar lay down for a long time, finally raised its head and arched it three times toward the forest.
The other mortal beasts followed suit and lowered themselves, with their front legs bent and their foreheads touching the ground.
The wild boar swallowed the elixir, its fur exploded and fell down, and a layer of spiritual light appeared all over its body.
